metadata.title: Bevacizumab 5mg/kg and FOLFIRI Therapy -14 day
metadata.indication: Treatment of adult patients with metastatic carcinoma of the colon or rectum.

validation.audit_fixes_scope: v0.83.2 live-audit findings; see docs/RELEASE_v0833_CLINICAL_FIXES.md. Independent clinical/pharmacy validation pending.

metadata.partial_assessment_note: Any independently actionable entered value is assessed; omitted domains remain unassessed and do not block a partial result.
metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

catalogue_reconciliation.scope_note: The NCCP states that its website list is not comprehensive. This reconciliation does not assert that every possible national regimen is published online.

encoding_maturity.label: Encoded protocol · full source coverage review pending
encoding_maturity.scope_note: The protocol has executable SACTCheck content but has not yet completed the v0.68.0 full source fidelity review. Use the current NCCP source as authoritative.

metadata.catalogue_source_check_scope: Catalogue presence and source link structure only; not rule level source fidelity.
metadata.schedule_summary: Day 1: bevacizumab, irinotecan, folinic acid and fluorouracil, then a 46-hour fluorouracil pump. A cycle lasts 14 days; your team confirms the next treatment.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: The treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Any dose modification should be discussed with a Consultant.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: JSON assessment encoding for NCCP 00449 Version 6a. Audit corrections reconciled to this regimen's current source on 16 October 2026. Confirm the official PDF and use independent clinical judgement. Clinical and oncology-pharmacy validation remain pending.

indications.description: Treatment of adult patients with metastatic carcinoma of the colon or rectum.

output_templates.contraindicated: The entered data trigger a protocol exclusion or contraindication pathway.
output_templates.discontinue: The entered data trigger protocol discontinuation.
output_templates.withhold: Hold treatment and follow the protocol reassessment pathway.
output_templates.consultant_review: Consultant review is required before treatment proceeds.
output_templates.dose_reduce: Treatment may proceed only after the encoded component modifications are reviewed and prescribed.
output_templates.proceed: No encoded dose-modification criterion was triggered by the entered data.

rule_engine.conflict_policy: Use the most restrictive overall action; combine component changes using the greatest reduction per component rather than summing reductions.
rule_engine.missing_data_policy: Evaluate only supplied values; do not infer missing values. Eligibility/context fields remain optional unless a specific rule requires them.

rules.explanation: Hypersensitivity to irinotecan, fluorouracil or an excipient is an exclusion.
Pregnancy or breastfeeding is an exclusion.

action.recommendation: Review bowel disease/obstruction before irinotecan. This is a supplementary FOLFIRI caution, not an encoded exclusion from the 00449 table.

source.document: Supplementary NCCP 00227 v9 FOLFIRI (not a 00449 exclusion)

rules.explanation: Review bowel disease/obstruction before irinotecan. This is a supplementary FOLFIRI caution, not an encoded exclusion from the 00449 table.
Known complete DPD deficiency contraindicates fluorouracil.

action.recommendation: Use an individualised reduced starting dose and consider cautious escalation if tolerated.

rules.explanation: Partial DPD deficiency requires an individualised reduced fluorouracil starting dose.

action.recommendation: Obtain or verify DPD testing before first fluorouracil treatment.

rules.explanation: DPD testing is required before first fluorouracil treatment unless previously tested.

action.recommendation: Review baseline bowel function and suitability before treatment.

source.document: Supplementary NCCP 00227 v9 FOLFIRI (not a 00449 exclusion)

rules.explanation: Baseline greater than 3 loose bowel movements per day is listed as a caution.

action.recommendation: Consider a reduced irinotecan starting dose.

source.document: Supplementary NCCP 00227 v9 FOLFIRI (not a 00449 exclusion)

rules.explanation: For patients known to be homozygous UGT1A1*28, a reduced irinotecan starting dose may be considered.

action.recommendation: If ANC is below 1.5 ×10⁹/L on Day 1, hold FOLFIRI chemotherapy and repeat FBC weekly. Confirm delay duration and the persistent-toxicity stopping pathway before rescheduling. Bevacizumab may be delayed independently; review its own criteria and the timing of subsequent treatment (page 3).

rules.explanation: If ANC is below 1.5 ×10⁹/L on Day 1, hold FOLFIRI chemotherapy and repeat FBC weekly.

action.recommendation: Discontinue FOLFIRI chemotherapy. Bevacizumab may be delayed independently; review its own criteria and the timing of subsequent treatment (page 3).

rules.explanation: If ANC remains below 1.5 ×10⁹/L after 4 weeks, discontinue FOLFIRI chemotherapy.

action.recommendation: If platelets are below 75 ×10⁹/L on Day 1, hold FOLFIRI chemotherapy and repeat FBC weekly. Confirm delay duration and the persistent-toxicity stopping pathway before rescheduling. Bevacizumab may be delayed independently; review its own criteria and the timing of subsequent treatment (page 3).

rules.explanation: If platelets are below 75 ×10⁹/L on Day 1, hold FOLFIRI chemotherapy and repeat FBC weekly.

action.recommendation: Discontinue FOLFIRI chemotherapy. Bevacizumab may be delayed independently; review its own criteria and the timing of subsequent treatment (page 3).

rules.explanation: If platelets remain below 75 ×10⁹/L after 2 weeks, discontinue FOLFIRI chemotherapy.

action.recommendation: Reduce irinotecan and both fluorouracil components by one dose level.

rules.explanation: Lowest ANC 0.5–0.99 ×10⁹/L during delayed week(s): reduce irinotecan and fluorouracil one dose level.

action.recommendation: Reduce irinotecan and both fluorouracil components by two dose levels.

rules.explanation: Lowest ANC below 0.5 ×10⁹/L during delayed week(s): reduce irinotecan and fluorouracil two dose levels.

action.recommendation: Reduce irinotecan and both fluorouracil components by one dose level.

rules.explanation: Lowest platelets 10–49.9 ×10⁹/L during delayed week(s): reduce irinotecan and fluorouracil one dose level.

action.recommendation: Reduce irinotecan and both fluorouracil components by two dose levels.

rules.explanation: Lowest platelets below 10 ×10⁹/L during delayed week(s): reduce irinotecan and fluorouracil two dose levels.

action.recommendation: Reduce irinotecan and both fluorouracil components by two dose levels; G-CSF may be considered.

rules.explanation: Grade 4 neutropenia with fever grade ≥2: reduce irinotecan and fluorouracil two dose levels.
Irinotecan is contraindicated when bilirubin exceeds 3 × ULN.
Fluorouracil is contraindicated when bilirubin exceeds 85 µmol/L or AST exceeds 180 U/L.

action.recommendation: Current diarrhoea grade ≥2: hold FOLFIRI chemotherapy for up to two weeks. Confirm delay duration and the persistent-toxicity stopping pathway before rescheduling. Bevacizumab may be delayed independently; review its own criteria and the timing of subsequent treatment (page 3).

rules.explanation: Current diarrhoea grade ≥2: hold FOLFIRI chemotherapy for up to two weeks.

action.recommendation: Discontinue FOLFIRI chemotherapy. Bevacizumab may be delayed independently; review its own criteria and the timing of subsequent treatment (page 3).

rules.explanation: Diarrhoea remaining grade ≥2 after two weeks: discontinue FOLFIRI chemotherapy.

action.recommendation: Reduce irinotecan and both fluorouracil components by one dose level.

rules.explanation: Previous grade 3 diarrhoea: reduce irinotecan and fluorouracil one dose level.

action.recommendation: Reduce irinotecan and both fluorouracil components by two dose levels.

rules.explanation: Previous grade 4 diarrhoea: reduce irinotecan and fluorouracil two dose levels.

action.recommendation: Current stomatitis grade ≥2: hold FOLFIRI chemotherapy for up to two weeks. Confirm delay duration and the persistent-toxicity stopping pathway before rescheduling. Bevacizumab may be delayed independently; review its own criteria and the timing of subsequent treatment (page 3).

rules.explanation: Current stomatitis grade ≥2: hold FOLFIRI chemotherapy for up to two weeks.

action.recommendation: Discontinue FOLFIRI chemotherapy. Bevacizumab may be delayed independently; review its own criteria and the timing of subsequent treatment (page 3).

rules.explanation: Stomatitis remaining grade ≥2 after two weeks: discontinue FOLFIRI chemotherapy.

action.recommendation: Reduce both fluorouracil components by one dose level; maintain irinotecan.

rules.explanation: Previous grade 3 stomatitis: maintain irinotecan and reduce fluorouracil one dose level.

action.recommendation: Reduce both fluorouracil components by two dose levels; maintain irinotecan.

rules.explanation: Previous grade 4 stomatitis: maintain irinotecan and reduce fluorouracil two dose levels.

action.recommendation: Administer atropine 250 micrograms SC unless contraindicated; consider prophylactic atropine with subsequent irinotecan.

rules.explanation: Acute cholinergic syndrome requires atropine unless contraindicated; prophylaxis may be appropriate in later cycles.

action.recommendation: Withhold bevacizumab for uncontrolled or symptomatic hypertension on Day 1; initiate or adjust antihypertensive treatment.

rules.explanation: Withhold bevacizumab for uncontrolled or symptomatic hypertension on Day 1; initiate or adjust antihypertensive treatment.

action.recommendation: Discontinue the anti-VEGF component for severe haemorrhage.

rules.explanation: Discontinue the anti-VEGF component for severe haemorrhage.

action.recommendation: Discontinue bevacizumab for GI perforation, tracheoesophageal fistula or any grade 4 fistula.

rules.explanation: Discontinue bevacizumab for GI perforation, tracheoesophageal fistula or any grade 4 fistula.

action.recommendation: Discontinue the anti-VEGF component for an arterial thromboembolic event.

rules.explanation: Discontinue the anti-VEGF component for an arterial thromboembolic event.

action.recommendation: Withhold and obtain consultant review around surgery or impaired wound healing.

rules.explanation: Withhold and obtain consultant review around surgery or impaired wound healing.

action.recommendation: The source table does not assign bilirubin exactly 85 µmol/L or AST exactly 180 U/L. Obtain a Consultant dosing decision; do not infer a standard dose.

rules.explanation: The source table does not assign bilirubin exactly 85 µmol/L or AST exactly 180 U/L. Obtain a Consultant dosing decision; do not infer a standard dose.

action.recommendation: Hold bevacizumab; repeat 24-hour urine protein every two weeks. Resume on this criterion when protein is ≤2 g/24 h.

rules.explanation: Hold bevacizumab; repeat 24-hour urine protein every two weeks. Resume on this criterion when protein is ≤2 g/24 h.

action.recommendation: Discontinue bevacizumab when 24-hour urine protein exceeds 4 g/24 h.

rules.explanation: Discontinue bevacizumab when 24-hour urine protein exceeds 4 g/24 h.

action.recommendation: The 24-hour urine protein criterion permits bevacizumab at ≤2 g/24 h. Other bevacizumab criteria and unassessed domains still require review.

rules.explanation: The 24-hour urine protein criterion permits bevacizumab at ≤2 g/24 h. Other bevacizumab criteria and unassessed domains still require review.

action.recommendation: Withhold bevacizumab for a 4+ dipstick and collect 24-hour urine protein.

rules.explanation: Withhold bevacizumab for a 4+ dipstick and collect 24-hour urine protein.

action.recommendation: A 2+ or 3+ dipstick permits the scheduled bevacizumab dose on this criterion; collect 24-hour urine protein within three days before the next dose and apply the quantitative pathway. Any concurrent hold or stop criterion takes precedence.

rules.explanation: A 2+ or 3+ dipstick permits the scheduled bevacizumab dose on this criterion; collect 24-hour urine protein within three days before the next dose and apply the quantitative pathway. Any concurrent hold or stop criterion takes precedence.

action.recommendation: Discontinue bevacizumab for grade 4 proteinuria.

rules.explanation: Discontinue bevacizumab for grade 4 proteinuria.

action.recommendation: Consider a fluorouracil dose reduction in severe renal impairment only. The source does not quantify the reduction; obtain an individualised Consultant/pharmacy decision.

rules.explanation: Consider a fluorouracil dose reduction in severe renal impairment only. The source does not quantify the reduction; obtain an individualised Consultant/pharmacy decision.

action.recommendation: No renal-impairment studies are provided for bevacizumab in this source. Review suitability; do not infer a quantified dose reduction.

rules.explanation: No renal-impairment studies are provided for bevacizumab in this source. Review suitability; do not infer a quantified dose reduction.

action.recommendation: NCCP 00449 specifies no irinotecan dose reduction for renal impairment, but advises caution because information is lacking. For dialysis, obtain a specialist plan; this source does not specify a dialysis dose or timing.

rules.explanation: NCCP 00449 specifies no irinotecan dose reduction for renal impairment, but advises caution because information is lacking. For dialysis, obtain a specialist plan; this source does not specify a dialysis dose or timing.

action.recommendation: ANC recovery after more than two delayed weeks falls outside the source recovery wording. Confirm the FOLFIRI restart plan with the Consultant; assess bevacizumab independently.

rules.explanation: ANC recovery after more than two delayed weeks falls outside the source recovery wording. Confirm the FOLFIRI restart plan with the Consultant; assess bevacizumab independently.

action.recommendation: Moderate hepatic impairment: reduce the initial fluorouracil dose by one third; increase if no toxicity. Any bilirubin/AST contraindication takes precedence.

rules.explanation: Moderate hepatic impairment: reduce the initial fluorouracil dose by one third; increase if no toxicity. Any bilirubin/AST contraindication takes precedence.

action.recommendation: Severe hepatic impairment: reduce the initial fluorouracil dose by one half; increase if no toxicity. Any bilirubin/AST contraindication takes precedence.

rules.explanation: Severe hepatic impairment: reduce the initial fluorouracil dose by one half; increase if no toxicity. Any bilirubin/AST contraindication takes precedence.

action.recommendation: No hepatic-impairment studies are provided for bevacizumab in this source; review suitability without inventing a dose reduction.

rules.explanation: No hepatic-impairment studies are provided for bevacizumab in this source; review suitability without inventing a dose reduction.

bowel_obstruction_or_chronic_bowel_disea.label: Chronic bowel disease and/or bowel obstruction

diarrhoea_current_grade.label: Current diarrhoea grade
diarrhoea_current_grade.assessment_guidance: Count stools per day above the patient's baseline, assess ostomy output, continence, hydration, fever, abdominal pain, haemodynamic compromise and whether hospital care is indicated.

options.label: Grade 0
options.description: No increase above the patient's usual stool frequency or ostomy output.

options.label: Grade 1
options.description: Increase of fewer than 4 stools per day above baseline, or mild increase in ostomy output.

options.label: Grade 2
options.description: Increase of 4–6 stools per day above baseline, or moderate increase in ostomy output; limits instrumental activities of daily living.

options.label: Grade 3
options.description: Increase of 7 or more stools per day above baseline, incontinence, hospital care indicated, or severe ostomy-output increase; limits self-care activities of daily living.

options.label: Grade 4
options.description: Life-threatening consequences; urgent intervention required.

renal_impairment_severity.assessment_guidance: Use the clinically verified severity. NCCP does not provide a numeric cutoff or a percentage reduction for 5-FU in severe renal impairment in this regimen.
